bug.actual_behavior: The archive extracts successfully with pandoc.exe in the version directory, but the wrapper checks a bin/pandoc path and exits with pandoc binary not found after installation.
evidence: The extracted archive contains pandoc.exe, while the wrapper checks a Unix-style bin/pandoc path.
bug.expected_behavior: After downloading and extracting the Windows Pandoc zip, the wrapper should locate pandoc.exe and continue rendering.
bug.impact: 这是由 skill 设计缺陷导致的真实环境问题，需要纳入后续修复闭环。
reproduction_steps: Run knit_rmd_html.py on Windows without pandoc already in PATH.
Allow the wrapper to download and extract the supported Windows Pandoc zip.
bug.summary: Windows Pandoc auto-install checks a Unix-style bin/pandoc path instead of the extracted pandoc.exe
bug.workaround: Prepend the extracted Pandoc version directory containing pandoc.exe to PATH and rerun with --no-install.
